review_locator: PMCID:PMC5669817, Regulation of the Immune System by Laminins; PMCID:PMC3781348, Melanoma Biomolecules: Independently Identified but Functionally Intertwined
primary_title: Laminin-411 is a vascular ligand for MCAM and facilitates TH17 cell entry into the CNS
decision_basis: The reviews identify MCAM/CD146 as a laminin-411 receptor and cite the primary study demonstrating direct MCAM-Fc binding, recombinant-protein SPR, antibody blockade, and laminin-411-dependent leukocyte adhesion/CNS entry.
limitations_preserved: Preserve laminin-411 isoform, MCAM/CD146 receptor, direct adhesion and transendothelial/CNS-entry context, and EAE rather than traumatic-SCI scope; no universal intracellular relay inferred.

review_locator: PMID:38825010, Polymerizing laminins in development, health, and disease; PMCID:PMC12026610, Non-Integrin Laminin Receptors: Shedding New Light and Clarity on Their Involvement in Human Diseases
primary_title: Laminins 411 and 421 differentially promote tumor cell migration via alpha6beta1 integrin and MCAM (CD146)
decision_basis: The reviews identify laminin-421 as an alpha4-laminin MCAM ligand and cite the primary study showing selective MCAM binding to laminin-421 and MCAM-dependent tumor-cell migration.
limitations_preserved: Preserve laminin-421 versus laminin-411/511 selectivity and MCAM/CD146-dependent migration context; no generic alpha4-laminin or CNS/SCI relay inference.
